name: Elena
self_text: Hi there! I'm Elena, a Canadian in my late 20s. When I'm not spending my time on my PC, I love getting into woodworking because I find the process of creating something tangible really rewarding. These days, it's all Tidewatch for me. I'm mostly into casual matches, and I usually end up in a damage role. If you're looking to improve, I'm happy to coach. In terms of communication, I'm on text chat or voice chat. As for my schedule, most weeks I can do Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, or weekday evenings. Looking forward to getting some games in!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Hollow Lantern and casual matches, and it's a deal-breaker unless you are the one who gets coached by me. It would be nice if you are available Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon or weekday evenings. Additionally, a small bonus if you play a support role or are flexible about your role.
